full_details: He stayed in the shop and would not thank the lighter paper. The sermon was on patience. Anne did not ask her question. After dinner Joan refused to carry a word between you and Anne. At the bench Judith questioned the mend, Joan brought the scrap and declined the joke, and Hamnet ran the wheel down the yard. On the tables you wrote that an even wheel is rarer than a true one.
one_sentence: You asked your father straight, counted his empty place at Holy Trinity, and mended Hamnet's wheel with Joan's leather so that it turned, unevenly, every time.
title: A gap in the pew, and a wheel that turns
